title: GTIN Barcode Validator
description: Takes a GTIN-8, UPC-A (GTIN-12), EAN-13 or GTIN-14 string (surrounding whitespace, spaces and hyphens ignored; zero-padding allowed) and returns whether its GS1 mod-10 check digit is valid, the format detected after stripping leading zeros (biip rules), payload, actual and expected check digits, and the gtin14/gtin13/gtin12 forms it can be widened to. Invalid input returns valid:false with error and message.
